decisions.reason: The two-sided wording decision applies only to the placard and does not change the spout's barista-facing orientation, geometry, material, or appearance.
Displaying the placard wording on both sides does not change the machine's beige body or green accent colors.
The placard orientation change does not modify the DJ-turntable visual theme or decorative controls.
The source changes placard visibility for two viewing directions and has no effect on bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or enclosure-size constraints.
Adding the same placard wording for both viewing directions does not necessarily alter the enclosure's dimensions or form factor.
The placard decision does not affect whisk selection, positioning, mixing quality, foam quality, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The passive placard wording and viewing-orientation change does not alter electrical loads, controller capacity, or overload protection.
The source concerns only placard wording visibility and does not change the dispensing mechanism, sequence, flow, or drip constraints.
Two-sided placard branding does not modify splash-control targets or mitigation methods.
The placard's two-sided wording has no effect on whisk removal, clearance, tool use, or swapping behavior.
The source does not change bowl removal, swapping, or mechanical-clearance requirements.
The placard wording decision does not necessarily change any component selection or the BOM deliverable, and the source requests no BOM revision.
